text: Both fixes are done in Laubrary. The Zound list now sits right under the toolbar instead of being pushed to the bottom, and the Volume/Chance readouts in each row shrink to fit instead of being cut off. The restored look and both fixes are also copied into HH2Lab, but I couldn't check them live there. Please click into the HH2Lab editor, open Laubrary > Zounds and confirm.
details:
What you'll see in Laubrary (checked by eye in the live window): with only two Zounds, the rows start directly under the filter buttons with no big gaps. 'Volume 57-67' is fully readable in a slightly smaller font.

One difference to know about: the Chance column in the list is narrow. When 'Chance: 100' can't fit even at the smaller size, it now shows just '100', and hovering still says Chance. Wider places, like the Klip editor, still show 'Chance: 100' in full.

Not yet verified: HH2Lab, live. That editor no longer has the agent bridge (Coplay was removed from it on 10 September), and I didn't want to install one or grab focus from you. It will pick up the changes as soon as you click into it. Then open Laubrary > Zounds; it should look like the attached Laubrary picture, but with HH2's own Zounds.

HH2Lab changes are NOT committed. That's yours to do there.

Noticed, not changed: when the Zounds window is narrow (about 760 px), the Volume/Pitch/Chance columns disappear completely and the tag text gets cut off (see the narrow-window picture). That was already the case before these fixes. Say if you want it handled.
technicalDetails:
Laubrary commit b6376425 on dev (only these 3 files; the rest of the dirty tree was left alone):
- D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\Editor\Zounds\TabContents\ZoundBrowsers\BrowserTab.cs (DrawBrowserBody, sideBy branch): removed the 4 vertical GUILayout.FlexibleSpace() calls around drawSearch/drawMasterVolume. Inside a vertical group they set stretchHeight, so the search+volume row swallowed all spare height. Both cells are fixed 26px, so there's no misalignment. The reviewer confirmed there is no other vertical stretcher in the Browser tab path.
- D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\Zui\Scripts\Editor\ZUISlider.cs: new ZUI.DrawFittedTrackLabel, used by DrawMicroSlider + DrawMicroMinMax. If the text fits it draws exactly as before. Otherwise it steps fontSize down to max(8, 70%) and, for LabelAndValue(s) modes, falls back to the bare value. The fontSize of the def's cached GUIStyle is restored in finally, because ZUISliderDef.GetLabelStyle is shared by every row.
- D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\Assets\Packages\Laubrary\CHANGELOG.md: two bullets under the T-0343 entry.

HH2Lab (D:\UNITY\HH2\HH2Lab, branch x/zounds-upgrade), UNCOMMITTED. D:\UNITY\HH2\CLAUDE.md forbids AI attribution in HH2Lab commits, and the owner commits there.
- Assets/Zounds/Editor/Zounds/ZoundsZUIBootstrap.cs: byte-identical copy of Laubrary's (HH2Lab's old file was byte-identical to Laubrary's pre-e5811d88 version).
- Assets/Zounds/Editor/Zui/ZUISlider.cs: byte-identical copy (was identical to Laubrary's pre-edit file; verified via numstat 54/4 on both).
- Assets/Zounds/Editor/Zounds/TabContents/ZoundBrowsers/BrowserTab.cs: the same block edit only. HH2Lab's BrowserTab otherwise differs, since it has the Recent mode, so the file was NOT copied.
- Sheet + .meta (GUID e20964114e799464eb4e977adca28957, unique in HH2Lab) at Assets/Zounds/Editor/Zounds/ZUI Assets/, plus the folder .meta (GUID 398731790179c9741aff86b04d578f96). Deleted the empty placeholder Assets/Zounds/ZUI Assets/ (asset GUID 46833420..., nothing referenced it) and its folder .meta.

HH2Lab live test blocked: its editor (PID 214008, launched with -automated -logFile D:\UNITY\HH2\HH2Lab\Logs\hh2lab-editor2.log) has no com.unity.pipeline package and no live Coplay plugin (Packages/Coplay logs stop 2026-09-10). Coplay's list_unity_project_roots still lists it, but execute_script returns 'not running'. An unfocused editor won't auto-refresh, so the log shows no import yet.

Captures: PrintWindow via D:\UNITY\Laubrary Dev\.agenthq\workspace\T-0343\capture-window.ps1. The Zounds window was narrowed to 760px for one capture and restored to 1082px. A 'Klip: New Klip' editor window was opened for a capture and left open.
